sourcePolicy: Fresh R4 fal narration plus original deterministic oscillators and noise; no third-party samples or previous campaign media.

films.title: BUILD AN EMPIRE

lines.text: Your next move could build an empire.
lines.eq: 75 Hz high-pass; 12.5 kHz low-pass; gentle 2:1 compression; mono center

lines.text: Crimes earn cash and respect. Heat follows.
lines.eq: 75 Hz high-pass; 12.5 kHz low-pass; gentle 2:1 compression; mono center

lines.text: Train your skills and build a career through action.
lines.eq: 75 Hz high-pass; 12.5 kHz low-pass; gentle 2:1 compression; mono center

lines.text: Steal a car. Salvage eligible wrecks into materials.
lines.eq: 75 Hz high-pass; 12.5 kHz low-pass; gentle 2:1 compression; mono center

lines.text: Discover recipes to craft, repair, and track your gear.
lines.eq: 75 Hz high-pass; 12.5 kHz low-pass; gentle 2:1 compression; mono center

lines.text: Build businesses. Run kitchens. Pay the people working them.
lines.eq: 75 Hz high-pass; 12.5 kHz low-pass; gentle 2:1 compression; mono center

lines.text: Move cargo through markets and risky convoys.
lines.eq: 75 Hz high-pass; 12.5 kHz low-pass; gentle 2:1 compression; mono center

lines.text: Recruit a Crew. Coordinate heists and harder targets.
lines.eq: 75 Hz high-pass; 12.5 kHz low-pass; gentle 2:1 compression; mono center

lines.text: Build a Family. Turn strength into territory.
lines.eq: 75 Hz high-pass; 12.5 kHz low-pass; gentle 2:1 compression; mono center

lines.text: Territory earns income while diplomacy shapes the fight.
lines.eq: 75 Hz high-pass; 12.5 kHz low-pass; gentle 2:1 compression; mono center

lines.text: Loans and escrow put consequences behind every deal.
lines.eq: 75 Hz high-pass; 12.5 kHz low-pass; gentle 2:1 compression; mono center

lines.text: Race, fight, and play the tables.
lines.eq: 75 Hz high-pass; 12.5 kHz low-pass; gentle 2:1 compression; mono center

lines.text: Rivals strike back. So do investigators, courts, and prison.
lines.eq: 75 Hz high-pass; 12.5 kHz low-pass; gentle 2:1 compression; mono center

lines.text: Protection costs. Death can end a character.
lines.eq: 75 Hz high-pass; 12.5 kHz low-pass; gentle 2:1 compression; mono center

lines.text: Your heirs, deeds, and reputation carry the legacy.
lines.eq: 75 Hz high-pass; 12.5 kHz low-pass; gentle 2:1 compression; mono center

lines.text: Seasons reshape the city while players build monuments.
lines.eq: 75 Hz high-pass; 12.5 kHz low-pass; gentle 2:1 compression; mono center

lines.text: Equip your Crew to take control and reinvest.
lines.eq: 75 Hz high-pass; 12.5 kHz low-pass; gentle 2:1 compression; mono center

lines.text: OMERTÀ. Build something worth defending.
lines.eq: 75 Hz high-pass; 12.5 kHz low-pass; gentle 2:1 compression; mono center

films.title: THE ECONOMY HAS TERRITORY

lines.text: Game cash and OMR follow separate economic circuits.
lines.eq: 75 Hz high-pass; 12.5 kHz low-pass; gentle 2:1 compression; mono center

lines.text: Defined missions and funded rewards put OMR in reach.
lines.eq: 75 Hz high-pass; 12.5 kHz low-pass; gentle 2:1 compression; mono center

lines.text: Spend on eligible gear, services, and upgrades.
lines.eq: 75 Hz high-pass; 12.5 kHz low-pass; gentle 2:1 compression; mono center

lines.text: Eligible spending refills the Desk’s existing token inventory.
lines.eq: 75 Hz high-pass; 12.5 kHz low-pass; gentle 2:1 compression; mono center

lines.text: The funded Window converts OMR to cash only.
lines.eq: 75 Hz high-pass; 12.5 kHz low-pass; gentle 2:1 compression; mono center

lines.text: Revenue can fund buybacks and rewards. Funding sets the limit.
lines.eq: 75 Hz high-pass; 12.5 kHz low-pass; gentle 2:1 compression; mono center

lines.text: Canonical sells route a nine-percent base fee.
lines.eq: 75 Hz high-pass; 12.5 kHz low-pass; gentle 2:1 compression; mono center

lines.text: Fees support development, RWA, community, and liquidity.
lines.eq: 75 Hz high-pass; 12.5 kHz low-pass; gentle 2:1 compression; mono center

lines.text: That liquidity allocation funds Core. Stability uses finite reserves.
lines.eq: 75 Hz high-pass; 12.5 kHz low-pass; gentle 2:1 compression; mono center

lines.text: Families contest future funded fees in seasonal Turf.
lines.eq: 75 Hz high-pass; 12.5 kHz low-pass; gentle 2:1 compression; mono center

lines.text: Sieges allocate funded escrow while principal stays protocol-owned.
lines.eq: 75 Hz high-pass; 12.5 kHz low-pass; gentle 2:1 compression; mono center

lines.text: Inventory bonds vest existing OMR. They do not mint more.
lines.eq: 75 Hz high-pass; 12.5 kHz low-pass; gentle 2:1 compression; mono center

lines.text: Liquidity commitments lock positions against prefunded campaign rewards.
lines.eq: 75 Hz high-pass; 12.5 kHz low-pass; gentle 2:1 compression; mono center

lines.text: Eligible assets use distinct onchain ownership rails.
lines.eq: 75 Hz high-pass; 12.5 kHz low-pass; gentle 2:1 compression; mono center

lines.text: Approved RWA acquisitions can reach eligible Street Deed vaults.
lines.eq: 75 Hz high-pass; 12.5 kHz low-pass; gentle 2:1 compression; mono center

lines.text: Acquisition, allocation, and delivery each have separate rules.
lines.eq: 75 Hz high-pass; 12.5 kHz low-pass; gentle 2:1 compression; mono center

lines.text: Every balance has a source. Every move has a cost.
lines.eq: 75 Hz high-pass; 12.5 kHz low-pass; gentle 2:1 compression; mono center

lines.text: OMERTÀ. The economy has territory.
lines.eq: 75 Hz high-pass; 12.5 kHz low-pass; gentle 2:1 compression; mono center

films.title: THE CITY REMEMBERS

lines.text: In this city, what you know changes everything.
lines.eq: 75 Hz high-pass; 12.5 kHz low-pass; gentle 2:1 compression; mono center

lines.text: A missing shipment becomes an investigation.
lines.eq: 75 Hz high-pass; 12.5 kHz low-pass; gentle 2:1 compression; mono center

lines.text: Clues connect people, places, objects, and history.
lines.eq: 75 Hz high-pass; 12.5 kHz low-pass; gentle 2:1 compression; mono center

lines.text: Your view is personal. Private intelligence stays private.
lines.eq: 75 Hz high-pass; 12.5 kHz low-pass; gentle 2:1 compression; mono center

lines.text: Find original evidence from two independent sources.
lines.eq: 75 Hz high-pass; 12.5 kHz low-pass; gentle 2:1 compression; mono center

lines.text: Share knowledge carefully: forwarded rumors are not proof.
lines.eq: 75 Hz high-pass; 12.5 kHz low-pass; gentle 2:1 compression; mono center

lines.text: Bring recipes and tools to the right facility.
lines.eq: 75 Hz high-pass; 12.5 kHz low-pass; gentle 2:1 compression; mono center

lines.text: Bring equipment while another player brings the intelligence.
lines.eq: 75 Hz high-pass; 12.5 kHz low-pass; gentle 2:1 compression; mono center

lines.text: Crew roles and Family authority decide who can act.
lines.eq: 75 Hz high-pass; 12.5 kHz low-pass; gentle 2:1 compression; mono center

lines.text: An Agent can read permitted context and propose a move.
lines.eq: 75 Hz high-pass; 12.5 kHz low-pass; gentle 2:1 compression; mono center

lines.text: Consequential proposals still need your approval.
lines.eq: 75 Hz high-pass; 12.5 kHz low-pass; gentle 2:1 compression; mono center

lines.text: You confirm. The server checks authority and resources again.
lines.eq: 75 Hz high-pass; 12.5 kHz low-pass; gentle 2:1 compression; mono center

lines.text: The operation changes the world. Its receipt becomes history.
lines.eq: 75 Hz high-pass; 12.5 kHz low-pass; gentle 2:1 compression; mono center

lines.text: The Director responds to real conditions with authored situations.
lines.eq: 75 Hz high-pass; 12.5 kHz low-pass; gentle 2:1 compression; mono center

lines.text: Divert cargo; exposure can trigger a new case.
lines.eq: 75 Hz high-pass; 12.5 kHz low-pass; gentle 2:1 compression; mono center

lines.text: Opportunities connect the next move to what actually happened.
lines.eq: 75 Hz high-pass; 12.5 kHz low-pass; gentle 2:1 compression; mono center

lines.text: Secrets and alliances give your decisions lasting weight.
lines.eq: 75 Hz high-pass; 12.5 kHz low-pass; gentle 2:1 compression; mono center

lines.text: OMERTÀ. Know more. Move together.
lines.eq: 75 Hz high-pass; 12.5 kHz low-pass; gentle 2:1 compression; mono center
